name: Citadel Exterior Index
exteriorLayerRule: Exterior Layer supplements Canon Core, Room Index, Room Render Definitions, Map Core, Render Core, Render Continuity Rules, and Image Reference Index.
Exterior views are room-like canonical locations but do not override interior topology.
Exterior architecture must map to active interior topology wherever a direct relationship exists.
All exterior renders follow the same pre-render approval and post-render audit rules as interior renders.

outsideOfCitadel.purpose: Canonical exterior representation of the Great Citadel complex as a single physical structure viewed from outside.

defaultRender.viewpoint: elevated aerial view, above the Citadel, looking northwest

exteriorStructuralCanon: One large main dome located on north side.
Eight smaller domes evenly spaced and directly integrated with main dome structure.
Each of the eight smaller domes has four attached smaller rooms.
One south room attached to the main dome structure.
South room represents Entry Hall exterior mass.
Bridge connects to Entry Hall exterior mass and extends southwest.
Bridge terminates at landing platform southwest of entire Citadel.
Garden is attached directly to west side of Entry Hall exterior mass.
structuralAttachmentRule: All exterior structures are integrated into one continuous complex.
No detached buildings, separated structures, free-standing annexes, visible gaps, connecting hallways, skybridges, or connector tunnels.
Every dome, room mass, and architectural component directly touches adjacent structure.
Citadel reads as one unified building, not many buildings connected by hallways.
exteriorGardenCanon: Exterior Garden must match Garden room canon.
Required: Zen garden, raked sand, rock garden elements, stacked smooth rocks, one small Buddha statue.
Garden remains west of Entry Hall.
bridgeAndPlatformRules: Bridge must be fully visible in exterior overview renders.
Near bridge attachment, entire bridge span, and far bridge terminus must be visible.
Bridge may not disappear into fog, terrain, clouds, or off-frame.
Landing platform is southwest of Citadel, not south/southeast/east/north/floating.
At far southwest end there is one small stone-and-brass landing platform for steampunk blimp arrival and departure.
Landing platform is not city-sized, not a large airport, and not larger than Entry Hall exterior mass.
airshipTrafficRule: A few distant blimps only; no large fleets, crowded skies, military formations, or commercial traffic corridors.
exteriorStations: Aerial Overview Station: above the Citadel, looking northwest.
Bridge Arrival Station: viewer on southwest bridge, looking toward Citadel.
Mountain Peak Station: viewer below Citadel, looking upward.
Garden Exterior Station: exterior view focused on Garden west of Entry Hall exterior mass.
North Dome Station: viewer above northern dome complex.
exteriorComplianceChecklist: Garden west of Entry Hall exterior mass
